mapper.sql: id, app_id, tenant_id, org_tree, grant_all, forbidden, delete_time, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user
mapper.select:
select tenant_app.id as grant_id, app.id as app_id, app.icon, app.name_cn, app.memo, tenant_app.forbidden, tenant_app.create_user, tenant_app.create_time from app join tenant_app on tenant_app.app_id = app.id
and tenant_app.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and tenant_app.delete_time = 0 and app.delete_time = 0
order by app.show_order
mapper.insert:
insert ignore into tenant_app (id, app_id, tenant_id, org_tree, grant_all, create_user, update_user) values
(#{tenantApp.id},#{tenantApp.appId}, #{tenantApp.tenantId}, #{tenantApp.orgTree}, 1, #{tenantApp.createUser}, #{tenantApp.updateUser})
